title: Lifecycle Hooks in Composition API
description: Use lifecycle hooks like onMounted, onUnmounted, and others.

slides.title: Lifecycle Hooks as Functions
Available Hooks
slides.content:
| Options API | Composition API |
|-------------|-----------------|
| beforeCreate | (not needed, code goes in setup) |
| created | (not needed, code goes in setup) |
| beforeMount | onBeforeMount |
| mounted | onMounted |
| beforeUpdate | onBeforeUpdate |
| updated | onUpdated |
| beforeUnmount | onBeforeUnmount |
| unmounted | onUnmounted |
| errorCaptured | onErrorCaptured |
| renderTracked | onRenderTracked |
| renderTriggered | onRenderTriggered |

Note: `beforeCreate` and `created` are replaced by the `setup()` function itself.

quizData.question: In Composition API, where do you put code that would go in the `created` hook of Options API?
quizData.explanation: The `setup()` function runs after props are resolved but before the component instance is created, essentially combining beforeCreate and created.
